# Northstar: notes for AI coding assistants

- Product principle: **Discovery and Chat are different experiences.** Read
  docs/discovery-and-chat.md before any UX, navigation, routing, connector or Discovery change.
  Chat is never the default destination after Discovery.
- Never fake connectors, results, ratings or photos. Fair housing: never rate neighborhoods.
- Xcode uses file-system-synchronized folders: add files to folders; don't edit project.pbxproj.
